the value of an established SMBC to brand trust and the mediating role of consumer engagement in the transfer of trust in SMBCs.
how consumer engagement can be leveraged by SMBCs to facilitate the transfer of trust from one party to another.
understanding how SMBCs contribute to the development of brand trust and how consumer engagement is a key mechanism to explain this process.

the consumer-to-consumer and consumer-to-marketers trust in a SMBC have positive impact on brand trust via consumer engagement.

the consumer trust in other trusted parties in an SMBC can transfer to the brand through the mediation of consumer's engagement with SMBC, which in turn influences the consumer's perception of the brand.
consumer engagement mediates the relationship between consumer-to-consumer and consumer-to-markter trust and brand trust.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SMBCs are important for brand trust development, and consumer engagement is an important mediator in this process.
the SMBCs can be an effective tool for the firms to develop brand trust by leveraging on the consumer engagement.
the trust transfer in the community is mediated by consumer engagement and device usage, which in turn affects brand trust.
The main takeaway from our work is that
consumer engagement is a key factor in the trust transfer process, and that it can be leveraged to enhance consumer trust in the brand.
SMBCs provide a platform for firms to develop trust with consumers by transferring consumer trust in other community members to trust in the brand.
